_intention: Team-shared Claude Code settings. Committed to git so every developer gets the same permission allowlist, env vars, and hooks. Per-machine tweaks belong in settings.local.json (gitignored).
_what_this_should_contain: permissions.allow - tools and bash patterns auto-approved without a prompt.
permissions.deny  - tools and bash patterns rejected outright (deny wins).
env               - environment variables exposed to every Claude Code session in this repo.
hooks.PreToolUse  - scripts that gate tool calls before they run (e.g. validate-bash.sh).
hooks.PostToolUse - scripts that run after a tool call (e.g. format-python.sh).
